posts.author: WuBlockchain
posts.text:
Bitcoin ETFs Draw $110 Million as Ether Funds Shed $88.6 Million

According to SoSoValue, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $110 million in net inflows on October 26, entirely driven by BlackRock's IBIT, bringing its cumulative net inflows to $66.24 billion. Spot Ethereum ETFs saw $88.58 million in net outflows, although Fidelity's FETH led individual fund inflows with $16.13 million. BlackRock is the world's largest asset manager, while Fidelity is one of the largest U.S. investment firms.

posts.author: WuBlockchain
posts.text:
Binance Files for Brazilian Crypto License Ahead of October 30 Deadline; Restricts 8 Services and Delists 22 Tokens in Brazil

Binance filed an application with Brazil’s central bank on October 23 through its local entity BBrasil to operate as a virtual asset service provider (SPSAV), ahead of the October 30 regulatory deadline, according to Blocknews. To comply with local rules, Binance began restricting eight services for Brazilian users on October 27, including crypto loans, margin trading, mining pools and cloud mining, while delisting 22 tokens, including USDE, USTC, DCR and XVG. Existing positions in affected products are generally limited to reductions or closures, with new positions prohibited. Binance also plans to complete the migration of Brazilian users to its local payment-account structure by October 29.

posts.author: WuBlockchain
posts.text:
Binance Says It Blocked Multiple North Korea-Linked Cyberattacks Over the Past Week, With No Asset Losses

Binance said on October 27 that its security team had successfully identified and blocked multiple North Korea-linked cyberattacks over the past week, with no damage to company systems or loss of assets. Binance noted that North Korea-linked hacking groups have continued to conduct social engineering attacks under the “Contagious Interview” campaign, using fake job interviews, coding tests, and software installation requests to trick targets into running malicious programs. The exchange advised users to avoid installing unauthorized software or executing code from untrusted sources, adding that it will continue strengthening security monitoring, threat detection, and internal security controls.

posts.author: WuBlockchain
posts.text:
Arkham: Justin Sun-Linked Wallets Hold $51.25M in PEPE, Accounting for 2.82% of Supply

According to Arkham, wallets it has labeled or tentatively attributed to Justin Sun collectively hold approximately $51.25 million in PEPE, representing 2.82% of the token's total supply, potentially making him the largest individual PEPE holder. Arkham tracked two transfers from Poloniex to the associated wallets on October 17 and 26, worth approximately $28.44 million and $20.32 million, respectively, totaling $48.76 million. Between October 15 and 25, wallets already labeled as belonging to Sun also transferred approximately $77 million in stablecoins to Poloniex. Some of the PEPE had previously moved between Binance, HTX and Poloniex.

posts.author: WuBlockchain
posts.text:
Genius Launches Mobile App Integrating Token Trading, Creation, and Social Features on BNB Chain

Onchain trading platform Genius has launched its mobile app on Apple's App Store and Google Play. Built on BNB Chain, it combines token trading, social features, and token creation. Users can trade cryptocurrencies, follow other traders, explore market activity, and share insights from their phones. Integrated Genius fun lets users create tokens, select trading pairs, and launch new tokens. Genius fun launched on BNB Chain in September, and the new app brings these existing features to mobile.
